question: Which ATT&CK tactics does the detection analytic AN1955 belong to?

authored_steps.sub_question: Which ATT&CK tactics does the detection analytic AN1955 belong to?
authored_steps.query: MATCH (n) WHERE coalesce(n.attack_id, n.id) IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (n)<-[:HAS_ANALYTIC]-(m0) WHERE n:Analytic OR NOT (n:Analytic OR n:Tactic) WITH n, collect(DISTINCT {m: m0, r: 'HAS_ANALYTIC'}) AS h0 OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:HAS_TECHNIQUE]->(m1) WHERE n:Tactic OR NOT (n:Analytic OR n:Tactic) WITH n, h0, collect(DISTINCT {m: m1, r: 'HAS_TECHNIQUE'}) AS h1 OPTIONAL MATCH (n)<-[:HAS_ANALYTIC]-()-[:DETECTS]->(m2) WHERE n:Analytic OR NOT (n:Analytic OR n:Tactic) WITH n, h0, h1, collect(DISTINCT {m: m2, r: 'DETECTS'}) AS h2 OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:HAS_TECHNIQUE]->()<-[:DETECTS]-(m3) WHERE n:Tactic OR NOT (n:Analytic OR n:Tactic) WITH n, h0, h1, h2, collect(DISTINCT {m: m3, r: 'DETECTS'}) AS h3 OPTIONAL
